reviews.text: We have two Maine Coons, and Makis has been really helpful as our older male has started to struggle with a couple of issues. He was really knowledgeable, informative, answered all my questions, and left me feeling confident of how to move forward to help our cat.
Great help. First visit after having poor service at different vets

What a joke, We will never ever use or recommend this one at Pudsey again or any Vets for Pets for that matter. All this company thinks about is your money Not you or your pet. The admin at Pudsey are absolutely useless and a waste of time. Do not use this one at Pudsey you will regret it.

My two kittens were booked in for neutering at Vets for Pets Pudsey , I can honestly say all the staff were amazing from the receptionists to the Vets , the vets had empathy and it is by far the best Vets I’ve ever been too , I found the prices very reasonable , I would highly recommend them to anyone.

Furchild has been a patient here for years. I must say that since maybe the past couple of years there seems to be a new set of staff working there, and as much as they have always been professional and polite, these newer people do seem a bit 'warmer' for lack of a better word. I feel a lot more comfortable asking silly questions now than I did before. And even though they took my son's crown jewels away, he still likes coming back here.

Absolutely amazing place all staff amazing and friendly  help you with everything you need treat your pets like there own have all my pets registered here now would highly recommend this vets to anyone as they go the extra mile

I have clearly seen some really positive changes since the take over and revamp of the surgery.
We have a large, amxouis rescue dog who would never enter the vets. Any time ee had to take him we would feel so nervous about how it would go and also feel a little judged for how he may act.
Since it has been taken over we have received a totally different experience.
The staff have all been so patient, kind and understanding and made us feel listened to. They have offered solutions that would cause the least stress for our boy. We took him for his booster the other day and for the first time ever he happily toddled into the surgery and took a treat from Nurse Liam.
The revamp helps the vets feel less medical and more homely for our pets.
Special mention to Liam who realky did go above and behond to help our boy and also help me in a anxoius time.
Thank you.

Amazing vet, couldn't of been a better experience from beginning to end and my dog absolutely loves the vet who saw her.
If you are struggling with where to go I would highly recommend Pudsey as they are wonderful people all round.
Thank you!

I cannot thank the team at this veterinary practice enough for the care, professionalism, and compassion they showed during one of the most stressful experiences imaginable. My dog unexpectedly required major emergency surgery, and from the very first phone call through to recovery, the entire team was absolutely incredible.

I would recommend this practice without hesitation to anyone looking for a veterinary team that combines exceptional medical care with genuine compassion.

What a fabulous experience I had this morning at vets 4 pets Pudsey , Naomi and colleague  welcomed me and my kittens with open arms , felt so at ease , lovely relaxed atmosphere pleasant surroundings

I had brought my kittens in for first vaccine flea and worm , the vet himself was so pleasant and so kind and caring to the kittens , and gentle, very pleasant to speak to

I would highly recommend this vet practice, have Ben using them for some time and wouldn't trust anywhere else with my beloved pets x  thanks Naomi and team you made my day Janice

First time dog mum and can be intimidating making sure you’re not missing anything and you’ve done everything you need to. Pudsey Vets4pets have been nothing but supportive in the whole experience meaning I can relax about my dog’s health and just enjoy being a dog mum 🐾 …

Fantastic people providing excellent care and support. They look after our rescue dog Wilson who despite having very poor blackened skin when we adopted him as an eight-year old is now flourishing. He actually enjoys attending the surgery which is a massive bonus.
The team here are fabulous, you feel so welcome and looked after by the reception team and nurses and the vets are great with my cats ❤️

Amazing service friendly and compassionate, couldn't recommend higher! Natalie was very helpful ❤️

Sam and Percy x

Absolutely 5* service, care and consideration for my pooch. The staff are all wonderful and calmed my nerves, a lovely environment and atmosphere. My dog literally ran in there on our 2nd appointment, which is a great sign and I've seen first-hand how attentive and loving they are towards the animals. Thank you so much!
I can’t recommend these guys enough - Compassionate and professional in every aspect, all the staff were incredibly understanding and helpful. Prices are very reasonable too. Thanks so much ❤️

I have all my 4 cats registered with vets for pets in Pudsey, ranging from different ages. They treat you like one of there family, and treat my cats like there own pets. Robbie, colin, alan and moggy has never never had a bad experience from this company. Ive actually changed vets to these guys because they are trusted, professional and always look after you and your pets. The prices are extremely reasonable, especially since i have 4 cats to look after!!! They always remember your voice on the phone, treated with respect at all times. I can not recommend vets for pets in pudsey highly enough, these guys, and girls go above and beyond to make sure you feel confident in looking after your pets, well done

I've visited V4P Pudsey since 2001 first with my dog and then with 5 cats throughout the years. It has always been 5 star service, knowledgeable and most importantly everyone loves the furbabies and I've never worried leaving any of them in their care. Twice I've had to do the worst and say goodbye to my old pupper in 2018 and my Albie Cat in 2024. The nurses were so caring and compassionate and the kind of people you need around in the hardest times you'll experience. I've recently moved out of area and my final visit to the surgery 2 weeks ago was actually one of the more emotional goodbyes I made. I hope my boys new vets are half the team you guys are! Thank you for caring for my boys for the last 25 years 💜💜💜

The vets here are lovely with our cat. Affordable and appointments can work around people that work 9-5s.
Our little man went for neutering and the vets were so good with him and I think they loved our cat Sox :)
We trust everyone at vets4pets to look after Tilly & Bella. All vets and staff go way beyond to help us.

I just popped into the vets to ask a question about my poorly cat.
Even though my cat isn’t registered there, the staff and the Vet Aimee were way more helpful than they had to be and helped me out without asking for anything for the privilege. I’m not suggesting they are doing freebies, just helped me out in a situation when I needed it. Highly recommend.

Wanting to give a huge thank you to all the staff and vets (cris and maki’s) for their kindheartedness and dedication to my doggy,it’s taken a few weeks and much time to find a conclusion to her illness I can not thank them all enough xx highly recommend great team xx

5* The staff go above and beyond they have made us feel welcome the girls who are normally petrified of the vets we so excited on there return check up after being spayed its a small clean vets with parking area, a great atmosphere the whole team came and said hi to my dogs and introduced them selves . I found vets for pets looking for a better price on spaying my to girls and I saved a total of £376 on them both. No costs were cut my dogs were incredibly well looked after, since using vets for pets ive decided to keep them here as I belive being a vet isn't just about helping animals its about bonding with them beforehand and making sure there owner feels comfortable enough to leave there pet, normally with a total stranger.. Taking the time to talk to myself and physically cuddle my dogs made a difference... Its not all about money there is a love for Animals.. Thank you for your great service time and patience with the girls..

A team of friendly and caring staff.
A huge shout out especially to Makis who is the most genuine, honest, down-to-earth, caring and friendliest vet ever! I would not want to take my cat anywhere else😻 …

Makis & Team — the absolute legends of pet care!

Huge shoutout to Maccy and his brilliant staff for looking after my cat Squeak — who, thanks to her charming personality, is now known in the clinic as “Growler.” 😹

From the moment we walked (well, I walked — she was carried like a furry ticking time bomb), the whole team were amazing. They treated her like a VIP (Very Irritable Pussycat), spoke to her gently, and somehow managed to keep all their fingers intact.

Maccy is an absolute star — calm, kind, and clearly loves what he does. The staff are just as wonderful — warm, funny, and genuinely caring. They turned what could’ve been a stressful visit into something surprisingly enjoyable (for me, at least — Growler may disagree).

Squeak’s back to her usual self now: grumpy, and glaring at me from across the room. Couldn’t recommend Maccy and his team more — they’re simply the best! 🐾💖
Absolutely fantastic vets! Amy was brilliant with my cat after castration! So easy to get an appointment all the staff are amazing I would not take my cats anywhere else!

A great little vets - staff are friendly and our little cat is always looked after and handled gently. Dr Makis is our favourite vet as he is lovely with our cat who is shy and quite nervous. The vet nurses are also lovely and great for claw trims and flea/worm spot treatments plus general advice.

We have the V4P vet plan which I think is good value, we get check-ups throughout the year plus flea and worm treatments included.

So grateful for the amazing Krystel who has helped deal with a complicated insurance issue and offered support, kindness and tissues when I was upset in the vets. She has kept me updated and contacted the insurance company for me to minimise my stress. As well, Renee who offered her kindness and lots of patience whilst I was upset in the waiting room.

Another shout out to Cristianna who helped fast track my puppy’s ultrasound and offered me reassurance and kindness. Thank you for caring for Barney.

Shout out to Gabi and Naomi who cuddled and helped Barney during his blood test and temperature checks too!

You are all stars xxx

I can’t thank the team at pudsey branch enough for your kindness in helping me try to revive my koi this morning.  He was suffering with bladder disease and I was in a panic. unfortunately I think Reggie was too ill and sadly didn’t make it, but it was kind of you to help me try. Xxx

A family member took their cat which had been flea and wormed 1 week ago and was told they was a lier just coz the cat wasn't flea or wormed by them selfs and I know the cat was flea and wormed as I'd done it myself for the family member
Took my cat Lucy to Vets for Pets Pudsey. Great staff with a lovely welcome. Staff are always helpful and very knowledgeable. Keep it up guys!!

Attended Vets for Pets for a dermatology specialist appointment with Dr Petridis . Our Cavapoo needed some allergy investigations.
Definitely recommend it. He is very attentive and gentle with our dog. Explained the process and the plan very clearly and ultimately improved our dog’s life a lot.
Drive past 5 other vets practices to get to this practice. Great vets and support team

I brought my Tommy in tonight and what a great experience when I was so worried about him. All of the staff here are so lovely, but the Vet Makis is the best we've ever seen. Every time we have seen him we have left and said he's the nicest person. He clearly absolutely loves animals and it shines when he's looking after your pets. The way he treated Tommy was amazing, just like you would your own beloved cat and he gave some great advice and treatment. Would highly recommend this vets, thank you again.

Had an emergency with Alfie.
Loving caring assistants took him in.
Vet gentle and thorough.
Would recommend this establishment.
Excellent reception staff, and caring lovely vet
Thank you so much to vet Christiana and Renee for all the help and support on Friday greatly appreciated my us and our dog Oscar 🐾 …
Great vets - really kind, knowledgeable and helpful.

Had a humping/dominance issue with one of our male bunnies brought him in for castration today and the girls were AMAZING. Kept me informed and really helped ease my daughter’s nerves. Really grateful to have this vets close by.
Great service for all our pets

I bring both my cat Odin and dog Siggy here, even after moving out of the area we continue to do so. The staff are just so lovely and caring. My dog was recently neutered here and she had a wonderful experience, she literally can’t wait to go to back to the vets to see everyone!
Thank you to all the staff for being so kind and loving with my fur babies, you all go above and beyond to make sure they are so well looked after when in your care.  Can’t recommend the Pudsey branch enough.
The best vets I've ever been to. The staff are so friendly and helpful, I can always get a same day appointment if I need one and the care is always above and beyond. Couldn't recommend enough!

Very happy with these vets, will definitely be sticking with them, especially Amy she is such a lovely lady always with a smile and can tell she loves her job with the way she handles the animals. Would highly recommend to everyone. Because you can tell all staff are there for the love of animals ❤️ thank you to all the staff again ❤️

I felt it was only fair to leave a review after at least 1 year after leaving this vet practice.
We’ve been with Vets4pets - Pudsey for 8 years. During this period we noticed a significant decline in the quality of service and care for our dog. Good vets moved on and there seemed to be a continuous staff turnover which was alerting. We noticed an increase in fees and unprofessional staff behaviour, especially the ones that replaced Ruth who was an amazing receptionist.
A typical example is that the practice makes it very difficult to get a medicine prescription. They charged £17 for the prescription and will only add the one item! So in our case we had to pay for 2. In our new practice the prescription costs £11 and can include many items but also it specifies that some items can be ordered twice.
There was a worrying pressure from Vets4pets to carry out expensive procedures that our new practice deem unnecessary. They had to run numerous expensive blood tests and traumatised our dog.
I would absolutely not recommend this practise and advise people to look around. Our precious dog is thriving now and looks forward to going to the vet.

Really disheartening experience at the vets today. I took my kitten to vets after she ate a foreign object and I was worried as she had blood in her stool. Lady behind the desk was so lovely and reassuring however when going in to the vet consult room the vets face was like a horrible picture she told me she didn’t have me down for an appointment today and why did I come with an unfriendly tone, I explained I was worried and I brought her in. The vet then proceeded to tell me that I should not just turn up without an appointment unless she’s is dying. How awful, where is the compassion for a worried pet owner! Fortunately I work in a professional where we learn about compassion and kindness shame the same cannot be said for her.

This is my second visit and the first was the complete opposite where I had a great experience and by this initial visit I decided to pay for the vets4pets pet plan. Today has made me question if I have chose the right vets to care for my fur baby.

Took my dog there in as she was fitting and struggling to breath they sorted her out briefly and let us take her home saying she should be OK but early hours she started fitting again so we took her to Birstall vets and they found she had lots wrong with her within 10 minutes, why could these diagnose these problems but pudsey vets didn't, end result we had to have her put down, maybe if these problems were noticed earlier she wouldn't have been let home and suffered. Don't get me wrong they were nice people but they should have diagnosed the same problems as they did at Birstall vets.

I have been coming to this place for years and have been happy with the service and care, however, last appointment was disappointing where the vet didn’t check my cat just given injections. Soon after seeing vet my cat fell ill and I had to rush to emergency where they found a lump and she had to have emergency surgery. After tests she has been diagnosed with lymphoma. This could be avoided! Now time is crucial as the cancer is spreading aggressively but treatment will be done in late stage and my cats life time is certainly affected.

Very friendly staff. Vet could explain a bit more about what injection and  other staff is has been done without asking every time after every procedure... Maybe print it out so owner had note saying how to make sure we following all instructions as every day everyone is pretty busy we could forget what Vet advice on face to face time. Which could cause some issues in the future xx (Just advice) Everyone happy as Vet did his job and provided on the paperwork and owner happy to read through it so he's not getting lost xx Other than that not expensive and nice team 🥰

I have been a customer of VetsforPets Pudsey nearly for 7 years, and I used to not have a very good experience due to increased hidden admin prices for insurance claims, but today I took my very elderly cat to them again, and the nurse, receptionist and vet was so friendly and warm, they explained everything to me very clearly, and how the treatment will be conducted and why it costs that much, and how it will impact my pet. They did a stirling job, and have been exceptionally kind and warm, so I decided that this needed a reward in this review. They were called Amy, Gabi and Laura who treated my pet today, and I am being eternally grateful for their service. THANK YOU.

I’m still debating writing this as I type, but I’m still very upset about my experience.

I visited here with my hamster, her 2nd visit to this vet (the first time was so issue at all I can say).

My hamster was handled in such a damaging way, she was picked up by the scruff of her neck, her skin squeezed so tight that her eyes were nearly popping out of her head, I’m not being dramatic here, I had to look away because I didn’t want to see it happen, they were 4/5’s out of her socket.

Anyone who is educated in hamsters knows to NOT handle your hamster like this as it can cause a prolapse in their pouch or eyes.

The veterinarian I saw showed no care for her at all, we were their last appointment and we definitely felt like it.

After holding her like that and diagnosing her with a prolapse, they got a pair of tweezers out of a pen pot and pushed it back in three times, each time it came back out as my hamster was under so much stress of being handled like this, ultimately they gave up.

I was given antibiotics and told to continue pushing the prolapse back in, and left the vets to my car and burst into tears. No animal, small or large should be handled like this and have unsterile objects used on them.

I’m going to look at another vet practice after writing this, as I can’t begin to think about bringing her back there if she needs assistance again. I don’t like speaking negatively about a profession I have so much respect for, but this has upset me for a week now.

I hope this vet treats any future hamsters in their care with more compassion, and more vets become educated about the biology of hamsters.
Always friendly and professional.
Brilliant staff good place to visit very quick with our cat bailey

We had our Staffy spayed a couple of weeks ago, all went very well and the follow ups revealed all was good. The staff are friendly and helpful. Best of all, our Staffy actually looks forward to seeing the staff there.
Always grate and my dog is not afraid to go ther
Friendly staff and very helpful

Our whippet puppy was losing weight dramatically. She was clearly in pain and antibiotics weren't working. Vets4pets were amazing. The team managed to diagnose SRMA a rare form of meningitis. They literally saved her life
Absolutely lovely staff ,very caring .
